title_en: On the corner of the Congress Street of Manastir, Super Apartment 1+1 for sale with a perfect location!!!
description_en: On the corner of Kongresi i Manastir street, Super Apartment 1+1 with perfect location for sale!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a building built in 2002, without an elevator, with a certified net area of ​​40 m2 and an actual area of ​​52 m2. It is organized in a spacious corridor that distributes it among the other rooms, starting with the living room together with the kitchen, a spacious room, a bathroom with a window and a balcony. Orientation is from East-South and West, which means that there is natural light throughout the day. The area where it is located is quite preferred both for residence and for investment, being very close to the center and the rental values ​​in this area are high. It has every possible facility such as nurseries, kindergartens, schools and any other service. The environment has recently been invested: parquet flooring, plumbing and electrical installations, doors, windows, etc. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
